conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: Hi, I'm 14 years old, and I'm a girl. I'm here because I've had acne on my face for about two years, and it's been pretty much every day. My mom is with me today.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Can you describe the type of acne you have, such as blackheads, whiteheads, pimples, or cysts?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I have a lot of blackheads and whiteheads, especially on my forehead, and some red bumps on my cheeks and chin. It's not too bad on my chest or back.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the severity of the red bumps on your cheeks and chin? Have you noticed any scarring, pain, or changes in the appearance of the acne over the past two years? Additionally, have you tried any over-the-counter or prescription treatments for the acne, and if so, what was the response?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The red bumps on my cheeks and chin are kind of small and not too bad, but they’re there. I haven’t had any scarring or pain from it. I’ve been using Persa-Gel and washing my face regularly, and it’s helped a little, but not as much as I’d like.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide information about any family history of acne or related skin conditions, as well as any potential triggers such as diet, stress, or skincare products that might be associated with your acne?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: There's no family history of acne or related skin conditions that I know of. As for triggers, I think the biggest flare was when I started school sports in the fall because of all the sweating. I wear sunscreen in the summer, SPF 30, and I try to take care of my skin with a cleanser and Persa-Gel. I don't really think my diet or stress affect it much.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the severity and distribution of your acne in more detail, and are there any associated symptoms such as pain, itching, or swelling?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The acne is mostly on my face, especially my forehead, cheeks, and chin. I have a lot of blackheads and whiteheads, and some small red bumps. It doesn't hurt, itch, or swell, and it's not too bad on my chest or back. The worst flare was when I started playing sports in the fall because of the sweating.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the size, color, and texture of the red bumps on your cheeks and chin? Have you noticed any changes in their appearance or any new symptoms such as itching, swelling, or pain?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The red bumps on my cheeks and chin are small, red, and a little raised. They don’t itch, swell, or hurt, and they’ve stayed the same over time. I haven’t noticed any new symptoms with them.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you tell me more about how often you wash your face and whether you use any other skincare products besides Persa-Gel and the cleanser?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I wash my face every morning, usually just with water and a washcloth, but sometimes I use the Elf cleanser if I feel really greasy. At night, I use the Elf Super Clarity Cleanser, then a toner, and finish with Persa-Gel. I also use a noncomedogenic moisturizer, but I’m not sure if I’m using it every day.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you tried any over-the-counter or prescription treatments other than Persa-Gel for your acne, and if so, what were the results?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't tried any other treatments besides Persa-Gel. I’ve been using it along with washing my face regularly, and it’s helped a little, but not as much as I’d like. I haven’t used anything else for my acne.
